mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances when CPIAUCSL YoY > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tightening labor market, which can lead to wage inflation and subsequently higher interest rates, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances when UNRATE < 4%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Real Personal Consumption Expenditures (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer demand, which is a positive signal for corporate earnings and thus positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances when RSAFS increases.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in Industrial Production (INDPRO) signals a weakening economy, which can lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances when INDPRO declines.

mechanism_narrative: When the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 2% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) is increasing, it signals a tightening monetary policy to combat inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances when FEDFUNDS > 2% and CPIAUCSL is increasing.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) combined with a decrease in the Unemployment Rate (UNRATE) suggests strong labor market conditions, which can lead to wage inflation and subsequently higher interest rates, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases sharply and UNRATE decreases
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances when PAYEMS increases sharply and UNRATE decreases.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in Housing Starts (HOUST) indicates strong demand in the housing market, which is a positive signal for economic growth and thus positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances when HOUST increases significantly.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in GDP (GDPC1) over two consecutive quarters signals a recessionary environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 declines for two consecutive quarters
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances when GDPC1 declines for two consecutive quarters.
